items.title: Tuts Washington Interview, 1968-09-02
items.q: Another little fella right in the name of Brandon, I was saying, he was a little kid.

ctx.x: Yesterday I tried, I tried. We had a piano, but I couldn't find Little Sammy again. On Saturday I found Little Sammy, but we had no piano. Yeah. Sunday we had a piano, but no Little Sammy. Yeah. Well, I'm. Now, yesterday would have been a fine day. I wish I, you would have, it would have been possible you would have caught me yesterday. Because I had a friend came there and he's caught me yesterday. I was sitting down like I'm nine. He's a good friend of mine. He's got an $800 spinet. Oh. And I just, when I'm not…

Adam? Adam. He's around Illinois somewhere. They tell me he never came back here no more. He stayed up there. He's good. He left here playing here. That was Jimmy Kato's cousin. Jimmy Kato was a very big fella. He played something on the other way behind him. Oh yeah. And little Butch, little Butch, they teach piano now. I meet him on the canal all the time. He's still living? Yeah, he teaches piano. Where's Deer? About my side. Do you know his real name?
